title: WonderMage
description: WonderMage transforms your server into an elemental battleground. Upon joining, players are assigned one of 8 unique elements — Water, Fire, Air, Earth, Ice, Thunder, Metal, or Nature — each with 5 powerful abilities to unlock and master.
body:
WonderMage transforms your server into an elemental battleground. Upon joining, players are assigned one of 8 unique elements — Water, Fire, Air, Earth, Ice, Thunder, Metal, or Nature — each with 5 powerful abilities to unlock and master.
⚡ Features

8 elements each with 5 unique abilities (40 total)
Mastery system — gain XP to level up and unlock stronger abilities
Full AOE combat — abilities hit all nearby enemies, not just one
Live HUD sidebar showing your element, level, XP bar, and cooldowns
Action bar cooldown tracker always visible during combat
Persistent data — element, level, and keybinds survive restarts and updates
Stunning particle VFX for every ability

🔮 How to Play
Right-click your focus item to fire your selected ability. Sneak + right-click to cycle between unlocked abilities. Level up by using abilities in combat to unlock the next tier.
📦 Requirements: Paper 1.21.1+
